author: Flebula
body:
In-Game ban.

Staff Member:
Myworld6 (and Pizza334)

Guilty? (Yes or No):
No

Why do you think you should be unbanned
I was permanently banned whilst playing a match on Castle Adventure for allegedly walking/sprinting while shifting or the 'No slow down' infraction. I am requesting to be unbanned because I am absolutely positive that I never have/will use(d) hacks in Avicus. I believe the infraction i was banned for was simply a glitch, which one of your moderators, Pizza334, confirmed is a legitimate visual glitch, and my brother, who is also a player on Avicus (OPTOBAT) knows that i do not hack at all. If you are still dissatisfied/skeptical about my claim, then feel free to watch an observe me for as long as you wish if I am unbanned, to prove that I simply just do not hack.

Any additional comments?:
I have been a member and player of Avicus for nearly 3 years and my profile, statistics and previous infractions do not correspond in any way to the infraction i was banned for today. 

Please reconsider your decision, I hope to see everybody back in game soon. Thank you - Henry (Flebula)
